id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

stepsData.description: Array of {@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorStep} components that this component is composed of

isVertical.description: Option to render a Vertical Progress Indicator rather than the default Horizontal Progress Indicator.

withDropdown.description:
Option to render a dropdown menu in each of the steps
If set to true, only the current active step will expand a dropdown on click.
The dropdown will typically have options for navigating between steps, but can also have other actions.

isSequential.description:
Boolean flag to enforce that steps can only be viewed in sequence.
If set to true, the steps cannot be clicked on for navigation.
If set to false, any of the steps within Progress Indicator can be viewed by clicking on them.
The status of the step you were on before clicking away will remain.
But the status of the new step you clicked on will become current and active.

showInProgressForCurrentStep.description:
Boolean flag to set whether icon of step changes after being selected.
If set to true, selecting a step will set the icon to be "In Progress".
If set to false, selecting a step will not change the icon.

showStepSubtitles.description:
Boolean flag to set whether the subtitle will be shown in the list of steps. To show the subtitle
in the children container, set `showSubtitle` in {@link UiSdlProgressIndicator#childrenContainerSettings}.
Does NOT apply to substeps, since substeps never show their subtitle in the list of steps.
Also does NOT apply to the children container.
If set to true, steps will show their subtitle below their title in the list of steps.
If set to false, subtitles will not be shown in the list of steps.

forceSubstepSelection.description:
Boolean flag to prevent parent steps from being selected.
If set to true, selecting a parent step will instead select the first substep.
If false, selecting a parent step will select the parent step.

stepListMaxWidth.description: Sets the max-width css value of the step list container.

height.description: Sets the height css value of the component.

childrenContainerSettings.description: Settings for the container that contains the children components from {@link UiSdlProgressIndicatorStep#children}.

emptyState.description: Empty state that will be shown if stepsData is empty.

currentStepIndex.description: Current step index for progress indicator.

currentSubstepIndex.description: Current sub step index for progress indicator.
